## Recopy v1.9.0 — Search, Notes, and Reliability

Find clipboard entries with recent searches and searchable notes, with improvements to image handling, refresh behavior, and Windows shortcut reliability.

### Highlights

- Reuse recent searches and optionally clear the search after a successful paste.
- Add searchable notes to entries without changing their original clipboard content; access note, favorite, and delete actions from cards.
- Bound list payloads and thumbnail processing, avoid stale refresh results, and move blocking image/file work off async workers.
- Improve image-file lifecycle, rich-text deduplication, and Windows hook session ownership.
- Remove an unused FTS index and its write overhead while preserving existing search semantics. Add repeatable performance baselines and a Windows acceptance report.
- Harden updater metadata and release synchronization.

### Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `Recopy_1.9.0_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `Recopy_1.9.0_x64.dmg` |
| Windows 64-bit | `Recopy_1.9.0_x64-setup.exe` |

### Notes

- **Back up before upgrading:** fully quit Recopy and copy the complete app-data directory, including the database and original images. The database migration is not compatible with directly returning to an older binary; rollback requires a consistent pre-upgrade backup and excludes later writes. SQLite may reuse freed pages without shrinking the database file.
- **macOS:** The app is not notarized yet. On first launch, right-click → Open → confirm. See the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/main/docs/macos-unsigned-app.md).
- Windows release-executable acceptance was completed with documented coverage limits. Multi-monitor testing is explicitly out of scope for this release; NSIS installation/upgrade was not manually validated. See the [acceptance report](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/v1.9.0/docs/windows-acceptance-results-2026-09-24.md).
- Performance samples are workload-specific, not a guaranteed speedup or proof that the application is leak-free. Preview transparency/contrast observations remain unconfirmed and are not claimed as fixed.

## Recopy v1.9.0 — 搜索、备注与可靠性改进

新增最近搜索、使用后清空和可搜索备注，同时优化图片处理、列表刷新及 Windows 快捷键可靠性。

### 更新内容

- 复用最近搜索，并可选择在成功粘贴后清空查询。
- 为条目添加可搜索备注，不改变原始剪贴板内容；卡片提供备注、收藏和删除操作。
- 限制列表传输量与缩略图处理并发，修复旧请求覆盖新结果的问题，将阻塞图片/文件操作移出异步工作线程。
- 改善原图文件生命周期、富文本去重和 Windows 键鼠钩子会话管理。
- 移除未使用的 FTS 索引及维护开销，保留现有搜索语义；补充可复现性能基线及 Windows 验收记录。
- 加固更新元数据和发布同步流程。

### 下载

| 平台 | 文件 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `Recopy_1.9.0_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `Recopy_1.9.0_x64.dmg` |
| Windows 64 位 | `Recopy_1.9.0_x64-setup.exe` |

### 说明

- **升级前请备份：**完全退出 Recopy，复制包含数据库及原图的整个数据目录。数据库迁移后不能直接换回旧版程序；回退需要恢复一致的升级前备份，备份后的新增数据不包含在恢复结果中。释放的 SQLite 页面可复用，数据库文件不一定立即缩小。
- **macOS：**应用尚未公证。首次打开：右键 → 打开 → 确认。详见[安装指南](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/main/docs/macos-unsigned-app.md)。
- Windows release 可执行程序已完成人工验收，覆盖限制已记录；本版明确不覆盖双屏，NSIS 安装/升级未进行人工验收。详见[验收报告](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/v1.9.0/docs/windows-acceptance-results-2026-09-24.md)。
- 性能样本仅代表指定负载，不承诺固定提速，也不证明不存在内存泄漏。预览透明度/对比度观察尚未确认，不列为已修复问题。
